---
title: "embedpdf failures in a self-contained page"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
---

This page is built with `embed-resources: true`, so each PDF is inside the
page. No embed on it can show its PDF. The checks in `tests/` open a copy of
the page with no other file beside it.

## A file that is not a PDF

The file `files/broken.pdf` holds text, not a PDF, so PDF.js cannot load it.
The embed shows "This PDF cannot be shown here." and a "Download the PDF"
link that saves the file as `broken.pdf`.

{{< pdf files/broken.pdf renderer=pdfjs >}}

## Inlined PDFs that cannot be decoded

These two embeds are written by hand, not by the shortcode. Each `data-src`
is a `data:` address whose base64 holds `@`, which is not a base64
character, so the browser cannot decode it. The first embed uses PDF.js and
the second the browser's own viewer. Each shows "This PDF cannot be shown
here." with no link.

{{< include files/undecodable-embeds.md >}}
